title: Beyond the Chessboard
next_chapter_hook: That will surpassing Heavenly Dao gazed at Chen Ji, as if waiting for an answer—and Chen Ji felt something awakening deep within his bloodline.

text.content: One moment, the voice of the Tianji Record was asking for his choice; the next, the entire space shattered like a broken mirror. Chen Ji felt darkness envelop his vision, then was wrapped in a boundless aura. That aura held no malice, yet was far from benevolent—it was like something transcending good and evil, observing him with the gaze one might give to an ant.
When he opened his eyes again, he found himself in a void. No sky, no earth, no reference points—only an invisible ground beneath his feet. And directly ahead, a massive eye slowly opened.

That eye... was not the Eye of Heavenly Dao he had encountered before. The Eye of Heavenly Dao was cold and mechanical, but this eye rippled with inexplicable emotions—amusement, curiosity, and a trace of barely perceptible anticipation. As if it had waited eons, finally encountering a being worth noticing.

dialogue.content: So you are the current holder of the Tianji Record?

text.content: The voice did not emanate from the eye, but resounded directly in Chen Ji's Mental Sea. It carried an indescribable antiquity—older than any scripture he had encountered, even tens of thousands of times more ancient than the Tianqing Sect's own inheritance.

Chen Ji forced himself to remain calm. He had witnessed countless grand spectacles—three major sects clashing, the Demonic Path invading, the Ancient Forbidden Land opening—yet now he felt as if he were standing at the true edge of a chessboard for the first time. All previous struggles had merely been self-amusement within the grid squares of that board.

dialogue.content: (Cupping hands) Junior Chen Ji greets... Senior.

text.content: He did not rashly inquire about the other's identity. Before understanding the situation, any reckless move could bring catastrophic disaster. This was the fundamental principle that had kept him alive under his trash talent facade—knowing when to cower and when to bare one's fangs.

dialogue.content: Interesting. For ten thousand years, finally one who knows his own worth. Unlike that presumptuous fool, you understand reverence.

text.content: That presumptuous fool? Chen Ji's heart tightened. He keenly caught the keyword—ten thousand years ago. This meant the lifespan of the presence before him spanned at least ten millennia. And from the information he had gleaned from the Tianji Record Fragment, ten thousand years ago was precisely when that great cataclysm occurred.

dialogue.content: You must be wondering what happened ten thousand years ago. That little eye—what you call the Eye of Heavenly Dao—is it the pinnacle of existence?

text.content: Before the words finished, a hint of disdain flickered within that massive eye. Chen Ji had never witnessed such blatant contempt—not directed at any person or faction, but a俯瞰 of the entire Heavenly Dao. As if the Eye of Heavenly Dao was merely the most ordinary piece on a chessboard in its view.

dialogue.content: It was merely a piece I casually discarded, to observe the workings of this realm for me. All your so-called geniuses, predictors, protagonists—merely scurrying about on the chessboard I have laid out.

text.content: Chen Ji's heart slammed violently. He felt as if stripped of all disguises, exposed under scrutiny from a higher dimension. The act of playing weak to devour the strong, the meticulous scheming—all his stratagems were but children's games before this presence.

But he did not panic. The more dangerous the situation, the calmer one must be. This was an instinct carved into his bones. Panic only shows weakness to enemies; calmness, at the very least, lets you die with dignity.

dialogue.content: (Speaking slowly) Senior mentioned someone ten thousand years ago who was presumptuous... was that the person who tried to challenge you?

text.content: An elusive undertone entered that voice, as if recalling some distant memory. Within the void, countless specks of light began to coalesce, forming a blurry image. Chen Ji saw a figure—long hair billowing, spine straight as a sword, standing beneath the heavens and gazing directly at the Eye of Heavenly Dao.

The outline of that figure... why was it so familiar? Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. In that figure's features, he saw something connected to his own bloodline. What shocked him more was the cultivation technique the figure employed—the prototype of the Tianji Record.

dialogue.content: His name was Chen Tianji, the first master of the Tianji Record. He was also the first person to attempt to jump out of the chessboard.

choice.prompt: Chen Tianji is your ancestor. Ten thousand years ago he attempted to challenge this existence and failed. Now, you must decide how to face this truth.

choices.description: Since the ancestor could fight, so can you. The ancestor's failure does not mean you will fail. After ten thousand years of cycles, someone must break this chess game.

choices.visible_reward: Potentially acquiring power beyond the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: The consequences of provoking an unknown existence are unpredictable

text.content: Chen Ji's back straightened, facing that supreme gaze without the slightest retreat. What the ancestor accomplished ten thousand years ago, Chen Ji dared to do the same.

dialogue.content: This junior dares—to attempt the unfinished work of the ancestor!

choices.description: Since the other party wants to watch a show, let's give them a spectacular performance. Gauge this existence's bottom line and intentions, turn them to our advantage. The ancestor lost by being too direct—you are more adept at restraint than him.
choices.visible_cost: Potentially being used as a tool
choices.visible_reward: Potentially gaining intelligence and opportunities beyond the ordinary
choices.risk_hint: Playing with fire is extremely dangerous

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his gaze, hiding the shock in the depths of his eyes. He was calculating rapidly—if this existence had actively appeared and shared such往事, it must have ulterior motives. And with motives, there is room for negotiation.

dialogue.content: (After contemplation) The senior特意告诉晚辈这些，想必不只是为了缅怀先人。晚辈愿闻其详。

choices.description: Confrontation and exploitation are both thoughts within the chessboard. You must find that path even this existence could not foresee—the possibility of escaping beyond the game.
choices.visible_cost: The path ahead is unknown, there may be no retreat
choices.visible_reward: Perhaps carving out an unprecedented path
choices.risk_hint: The path of transcendence has never been successfully traversed

text.content: Chen Ji did not rush to respond. In his Mental Sea, he flipped through every page of the Tianji Record fragments, trying to find a clue within those incomplete records. If the Tianji Record could foresee three hours ahead, could it also foresee the path of transcendence?

dialogue.content: (In a low voice) The senior said the ancestor wanted to jump out of the chessboard... Then this junior asks, besides jumping out, is there another way?

text.content: That Supreme Existence seemed to sense something. It did not immediately respond to Chen Ji's three options, but instead cast its gaze toward a deeper void—where something was awakening.

The excruciating pain in the depths of his bloodline grew more intense. Chen Ji felt a flood of unfamiliar images pouring into his Mental Sea—flames, battle cries, a shattered sky, and a pair of eyes identical to his own. Those were Chen Tianji's dying memories, forcibly pouring into his divine soul.

dialogue.content: Interesting. You carry his blood and inherited part of his obsession. When he failed, he sealed a wisp of his remnant will into the bloodline, waiting for a descendant to finish his unfinished business. Ten thousand years, and finally a relatively qualified inheritor has arrived.

text.content: Chen Ji knelt on one knee, cold sweat soaking his forehead. The remnant will of his ancestor Chen Tianji was merging with his divine soul—a tearing kind of agony—as if two souls were ripping apart within the same body. But he gritted his teeth and held on, not letting out a single moan.

He saw it. The complete layout of ancestor Chen Tianji back then—the Tianji Record was not this existence's creation, but a fragment Chen Tianji had stolen from some higher-dimensional being. And what Chen Tianji truly wanted was that core chess piece controlling the entire game.

But he failed. The core chess piece's power was too overwhelming. The moment Chen Tianji touched it, he was rebuked. He only had time to seal a wisp of remnant consciousness into his bloodline before being destroyed. And that core chess piece sank back into a deeper void.

dialogue.content: You are different from him. He was too proud, always wanting to overturn the entire board by his own strength. And you... you are thinking about how to use the rules on the board.

text.content: Chen Ji slowly stood up, the pain in his bloodline gradually subsiding, replaced by an unprecedented clarity. Although the ancestor's memories were merely fragments, they suddenly deepened his understanding of the Tianji Record by several levels.

He sensed it. What the ancestor left behind was not only remnant consciousness but also a faint thread of clues—that path the ancestor had exhausted his entire life trying to traverse but never succeeded. And now, this path seemed to reappear beneath his feet.

dialogue.content: I give you a chance. You can choose to challenge me like your ancestor, then fail, perish, and become the next remnant consciousness sealed into a bloodline. Or...

text.content: The enormous eye flickered with flowing light, as if waiting for something. Its words cut off abruptly, leaving Chen Ji with a meaningful blank.

choice.prompt: The supreme being presented two starkly different options—follow the ancestor's footsteps, or find a completely new path?

choices.description: Although the ancestor's path failed, it at least proves that path was feasible. You must walk it more steadily and further, making up for his shortcomings from that year.

text.content: The ancestor's remnant consciousness stirred in the bloodline, as if urging him to make a choice. It was an obsession spanning ten thousand years, fervent and mad. Chen Ji closed his eyes, letting that force guide his soul.

In an instant, countless images flooded into his Mental Sea—those were Chen Tianji's lifetime of cultivation insights, his understanding of the Tianji Record, and every detail of his final challenge against the Transcender. Chen Ji felt he was inheriting a ten-thousand-year legacy.

choices.description: The ancestor failed, proving that path leads nowhere. You will not repeat his mistakes but must find that path even the ancestor never imagined—the third possibility beyond challenge and submission.

text.content: Chen Ji paid no attention to the agitation in his bloodline. He was thinking rapidly—the ancestor's failure lay in his desire to directly overturn the chessboard, and this presence before him was so certain, clearly unafraid of being challenged. That proved the path of challenge was, from the very beginning, within the other's expectations.

dialogue.content: (Raising his eyes) Senior, I wish to ask—is there a third road besides challenge and submission?

text.content: In the void, that eye of the supreme being suddenly brightened. It was a light Chen Ji had never seen—not contempt, not amusement, but genuine... interest. As if ten thousand years of waiting had finally received a response.

dialogue.content: Interesting. For ten thousand years, someone has finally asked this question.

text.content: The enormous eye slowly closed, then transformed into a flowing light that entered Chen Ji's Brow Center. A torrential stream of information rushed into his Mental Sea—that was about the deepest truths of this heaven and earth, about realms beyond the chessboard, about the true meaning of the word 'transcendence'.

Chen Ji's body trembled violently. The truth that the ancestor Chen Tianji had exhausted his entire life without being able to touch was now slowly unfolding within Chen Ji's Mental Sea. So it turned out that the so-called eye of heavenly way, the so-called fate chessboard, were merely games of beings from higher planes. And true transcendence was breaking not just the chessboard, but the rules that created the chessboard itself.

dialogue.content: You are quite interesting. Perhaps you can walk a different path.

text.content: That voice gradually faded away, and the void space began to collapse. But before it completely vanished, Chen Ji heard the final words—

dialogue.content: Don't make me wait too long. When we meet again, I want to see your answer.

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, finding himself still standing before the Tianji Record Fragment. It was as if everything just now was merely an illusion. But the mark that had appeared in his Mental Sea told him—it was not a dream.

He lowered his head to look at his own hands, and a faint pattern was emerging on his palms. That was a mark left by the Transcender—and also a certain covenant between him and that supreme being. From this moment on, his destiny trajectory had completely changed.

Ancestor Chen Tianji wanted to overturn the chessboard, only to result in death and the destruction of his Dao; while he, Chen Ji, would tread a path even the Transcender had never anticipated. He didn't know where this road leads, but he knew—the battlefield outside the chess game would be Chen Ji's new domain.

In the Mental Sea, the voice of the Tianji Record sounded again, this time carrying an unprecedented solemnity: 'Master, the thing you touched is far more dangerous than I anticipated. But since you have made your choice, I will do everything in my power to assist you.' After a pause, it added, 'However, before that, I must remind you of one thing—your ancestor's remnant will in your bloodline is competing with your soul for dominance. If you cannot achieve complete fusion within forty-nine days, you might...'

dialogue.content: A cold smile curled at the corner of his lips. Forty-nine days? That's enough. Even more generous than I anticipated.

text.content: Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, gazing toward the brightening horizon outside the window. The path his ancestor failed to traverse ten thousand years ago now rests upon his shoulders. And that puppet called the Eye of Heavenly Dao, along with the existence behind it who believes it controls everything—one day, he will make them understand what it truly means to have a strategy without any oversight.
